content.text: The project budget totals €160,242. A critical high-risk finding reveals a calculation error in the summary block, where the gross total does not match the net amount plus VAT. Additionally, ten medium-risk items (approx. €14,818) lack mandatory technical specifications required by VOB/C § 4.2.1, including details for asphalt, paving, insulation, concrete, and masonry. These omissions create significant risks for cost disputes and non-compliance. Immediate action is required to correct the arithmetic error and supplement all affected line items with complete technical data before issuing the tender to ensure accurate pricing and legal compliance.
